item.title: Apache Groovy & Apache Grails — Hackathon at Community over Code Glasgow 2026
item.description: Community over Code 2026 — Glasgow, UK, October 11–14 Register now | Event website | Hackathon overview Apache Groovy & Apache Grails — Hackathon Groovy and Grails are running a joint hackathon session. The two communities overlap heavily, and quite a few of the interesting topics (application generation, CLI ergonomics, compiler and AST behaviour, documentation) sit right on the boundary between the projects — so we’re sharing a table and encouraging cross-pollination rather than splitting into two rooms.

item.title: Apache NuttX — Hackathon at Community over Code Glasgow 2026
item.description: Community over Code 2026 — Glasgow, UK, October 11–14 Register now | Event website | Hackathon overview Apache NuttX — Hackathon Coordinator Alin Jerpelea — jerpelea@apache.org What We’re Working On We will introduce you to NuttX RTOS and show you how to build and run it from scratch on an embedded board. There will be twenty SONY Spresense IoT boards available for demos and demonstrations. You can also bring your favourite board and we can try to run NuttX on it as well.

item.title: Glasgow Tourist Highlights
item.description: Community over Code Glasgow 2026 - October 11-14, Hilton Glasgow Attending Community over Code Glasgow? Here are the top things to see and do in Glasgow beyond the conference. Most are free and within easy reach of the venue. Top Free Attractions Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum What: World-class art and natural history museum in a stunning red sandstone building. 22 galleries, everything from Dali to dinosaurs. Where: Argyle Street, Glasgow G3 8AG (map) Cost: Free Time needed: 2-3 hours Glasgow Cathedral What: Medieval cathedral dating to the 12th century - one of the few Scottish medieval churches to survive the Reformation intact Where: Castle Street, Glasgow G4 0QZ (map) Cost: Free Time needed: 45 min - 1 hour Glasgow Necropolis What: Atmospheric Victorian cemetery on a hill behind the Cathedral.

item.title: Hackathon at Community over Code Glasgow 2026
item.description: Community over Code 2026 — Glasgow, UK, October 11–14 Hackathon Hackathon We’re bringing back the hackathon! Community over Code Glasgow will include dedicated time and space for contributors — new and experienced — to sit together and work on real tasks: fixing bugs, writing docs, tackling issues that need focused attention, and onboarding new contributors. How it works Each participating project provides: A point of contact — someone present at the event to coordinate A task list — bugs, docs, features, good-first-issues, or whatever the project wants to focus on Promotion — letting their community know this is happening During the event, a dedicated room will be available for contributors to gather, collaborate, and get things done.
